dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear trailing edge with zero measurable curvature; non-falcate profile based on low-polygon mesh geometry.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute, single-vertex point with a pixel radius nearing zero.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior incline of approximately 75 degrees relative to the dorsal ridge line.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Coarse convex arc defined by distinct faceted segments rather than a smooth spline.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle of approximately 160 degrees at the junction of the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Low-polygon 3D mesh structure with visible faceted edges and an artificial cyan-to-white gradient texture map.
